column1: # M3_INTEGRATE product areas (P1): m3/<area> Maven modules whose product code still lives outside src/.
# The whole area directory is P1: its scripts run next to its pom.xml and src/ (cd "$(dirname "$0")", bare src/...),
# so splitting a module directory between m3/ and make/m3 would break them. The proposed homes: code parts (src/,
# test/, tests/, native/, include/, legal/) -> src/<module>, test/jdk; the Maven bridge and the area's records ->
# make/m3/<area>/ (the area's own move_area.py / move_module_area.py run decides at move time).
# Areas already moved into src/ (arrays, collections, paradigm, optane, compression) keep only their Maven bridge,
# which is build glue and follows P2. Columns (tab separated):
# status HOLD_P1: the target module exists; the area moves with its own move_area.py / move_module_area.py run
# (package rename where java.base) and gates, one area per PR. HOLD_APPROVAL: the module root does not exist in
# src/; creating it needs the user's approval (no new module roots without approval, 2026-11-08).
